versions.label: Responsive embed mode + smoother watch loops
changes: Loaded both apps in a compact embed mode so the full game canvases and side panels fit more cleanly inside the comparison layout.
Reduced jerkiness by making the watch loops delta-time aware and capping background training work per frame in the originating apps.
Kept the shared results panel and synchronized controls while tightening the iframe layout for side-by-side use.

versions.label: Matched pacing + shared results summary
changes: Reworked shared cadence controls so Evolution and RL now receive the same numeric training tick rate instead of percentages of different slider maxima.
Added a shared comparison results panel that extracts live metrics from both embedded apps and summarizes them side by side.
Adjusted the batch-advance mapping so the top-level controls move both apps forward more evenly.

versions.label: Initial side-by-side comparison lab
changes: Added a dedicated compare page that embeds Pong Evolution and Pong RL side by side.
Added synchronized controls for common watch, reset, step, speed, and training cadence actions.
Added compare notes, frame load status, and standalone launch links for both original apps.
